annotation.authors_or_issuer: Open Science Expert Group of the Estonian Research Council
key_provisions_or_claims: Research publications funded publicly should be openly accessible by 2020.
Funding applications must include data management plans covering publishing and licensing.
Research data must be preserved in standards-compliant repositories, machine readable, with metadata and persistent identifiers.
Data should be available as early as possible, ideally with publications.
Implementation assigns roles to key stakeholders with a schedule.
annotation.summary_en: Estonian Research Council expert group's 2016 principles and recommendations for a national open science policy, covering open access to publicly funded research publications and data, with 2020 objectives, stakeholder roles and an implementation schedule. Not about AI; mislabelled in the AI Watch collection as an AI strategy report.
